segments.mn148:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.mn148:2.1: “dhammaṃ vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhekalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ sabyañjanaṃ, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāsessāmi, yadidaṃ – cha chakkāni.
segments.mn148:2.3: Taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha; bhāsissāmī”ti.
segments.mn148:2.4: “Evaṃ, bhante”ti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
segments.mn148:3.1: “Cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbāni, cha viññāṇakāyā veditabbā, cha phassakāyā veditabbā, cha vedanākāyā veditabbā, cha taṇhākāyā veditabbā.
segments.mn148:4.1: “‘Cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbānī’ti – iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.mn148:4.3: Cakkhāyatanaṃ, sotāyatanaṃ, ghānāyatanaṃ, jivhāyatanaṃ, kāyāyatanaṃ, manāyatanaṃ.
segments.mn148:4.4: ‘Cha ajjhattikāni āyatanāni veditabbānī’ti – iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.mn148:5.1: “‘Cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbānī’ti – iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.mn148:5.3: Rūpāyatanaṃ, saddāyatanaṃ, gandhāyatanaṃ, rasāyatanaṃ, phoṭṭhabbāyatanaṃ, dhammāyatanaṃ.
segments.mn148:5.4: ‘Cha bāhirāni āyatanāni veditabbānī’ti – iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.mn148:6.1: “‘Cha viññāṇakāyā veditabbā’ti – iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.mn148:6.3: Cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, sotañca paṭicca sadde ca uppajjati sotaviññāṇaṃ, ghānañca paṭicca gandhe ca uppajjati ghānaviññāṇaṃ, jivhañca paṭicca rase ca uppajjati jivhāviññāṇaṃ, kāyañca paṭicca phoṭṭhabbe ca uppajjati kāyaviññāṇaṃ, manañca paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ.
segments.mn148:6.9: ‘Cha viññāṇakāyā veditabbā’ti – iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.mn148:7.1: “‘Cha phassakāyā veditabbā’ti – iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.mn148:7.3: Cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso;
segments.mn148:7.4: sotañca paṭicca sadde ca uppajjati sotaviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso;
segments.mn148:7.5: ghānañca paṭicca gandhe ca uppajjati ghānaviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso;
segments.mn148:7.6: jivhañca paṭicca rase ca uppajjati jivhāviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso;
segments.mn148:7.7: kāyañca paṭicca phoṭṭhabbe ca uppajjati kāyaviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso;
segments.mn148:7.8: manañca paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso.
segments.mn148:7.9: ‘Cha phassakāyā veditabbā’ti – iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.mn148:8.1: “‘Cha vedanākāyā veditabbā’ti – iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.mn148:8.3: Cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā;
segments.mn148:8.4: sotañca paṭicca sadde ca uppajjati sotaviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā;
segments.mn148:8.5: ghānañca paṭicca gandhe ca uppajjati ghānaviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā;
segments.mn148:8.6: jivhañca paṭicca rase ca uppajjati jivhāviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā;
segments.mn148:8.7: kāyañca paṭicca phoṭṭhabbe ca uppajjati kāyaviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā;
segments.mn148:8.8: manañca paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā.
segments.mn148:8.9: ‘Cha vedanākāyā veditabbā’ti – iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.mn148:9.1: “‘Cha taṇhākāyā veditabbā’ti – iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ.
segments.mn148:9.3: Cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā;
segments.mn148:9.4: sotañca paṭicca sadde ca uppajjati sotaviññāṇaṃ … pe … ghānañca paṭicca gandhe ca uppajjati ghānaviññāṇaṃ … jivhañca paṭicca rase ca uppajjati jivhāviññāṇaṃ … kāyañca paṭicca phoṭṭhabbe ca uppajjati kāyaviññāṇaṃ … manañca paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso, phassapaccayā vedanā, vedanāpaccayā taṇhā.
segments.mn148:9.9: ‘Cha taṇhākāyā veditabbā’ti – iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
segments.mn148:10.1: “‘Cakkhu attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati.
segments.mn148:10.3: Yassa kho pana uppādopi vayopi paññāyati,‘attā me uppajjati ca veti cā’ti iccassa evamāgataṃ hoti.
segments.mn148:10.7: “‘Rūpā attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati.
segments.mn148:10.9: Yassa kho pana uppādopi vayopi paññāyati,‘attā me uppajjati ca veti cā’ti iccassa evamāgataṃ hoti.
segments.mn148:10.13: “‘Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati.
segments.mn148:10.15: Yassa kho pana uppādopi vayopi paññāyati,‘attā me uppajjati ca veti cā’ti iccassa evamāgataṃ hoti.
segments.mn148:10.18: Iti cakkhu anattā, rūpā anattā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattā.
segments.mn148:10.19: “‘Cakkhusamphasso attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati.
segments.mn148:10.21: Yassa kho pana uppādopi vayopi paññāyati,‘attā me uppajjati ca veti cā’ti iccassa evamāgataṃ hoti.
segments.mn148:10.24: Iti cakkhu anattā, rūpā anattā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattā, cakkhusamphasso anattā.
segments.mn148:10.25: “‘Vedanā attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati.
segments.mn148:10.27: Yassa kho pana uppādopi vayopi paññāyati,‘attā me uppajjati ca veti cā’ti iccassa evamāgataṃ hoti.
segments.mn148:10.30: Iti cakkhu anattā, rūpā anattā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattā, cakkhusamphasso anattā, vedanā anattā.
segments.mn148:10.31: “‘Taṇhā attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati.
segments.mn148:10.33: Yassa kho pana uppādopi vayopi paññāyati,‘attā me uppajjati ca veti cā’ti iccassa evamāgataṃ hoti.
segments.mn148:10.36: Iti cakkhu anattā, rūpā anattā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ anattā, cakkhusamphasso anattā, vedanā anattā, taṇhā anattā.
segments.mn148:11.1: “‘Sotaṃ attā’ti yo vadeyya … pe …‘ghānaṃ attā’ti yo vadeyya …‘jivhā attā’ti yo vadeyya …‘kāyo attā’ti yo vadeyya …‘mano attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati.
segments.mn148:11.7: Yassa kho pana uppādopi vayopi paññāyati,‘attā me uppajjati ca veti cā’ti iccassa evamāgataṃ hoti.
segments.mn148:12.1: “‘Dhammā attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati.
segments.mn148:12.3: Yassa kho pana uppādopi vayopi paññāyati,‘attā me uppajjati ca veti cā’ti iccassa evamāgataṃ hoti.
segments.mn148:13.1: “‘Manoviññāṇaṃ attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati.
segments.mn148:13.3: Yassa kho pana uppādopi vayopi paññāyati,‘attā me uppajjati ca veti cā’ti iccassa evamāgataṃ hoti.
segments.mn148:13.6: Iti mano anattā, dhammā anattā, manoviññāṇaṃ anattā.
segments.mn148:14.1: “‘Manosamphasso attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati.
segments.mn148:14.3: Yassa kho pana uppādopi vayopi paññāyati,‘attā me uppajjati ca veti cā’ti iccassa evamāgataṃ hoti.
segments.mn148:14.6: Iti mano anattā, dhammā anattā, manoviññāṇaṃ anattā, manosamphasso anattā.
segments.mn148:15.1: “‘Vedanā attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati.
segments.mn148:15.3: Yassa kho pana uppādopi vayopi paññāyati,‘attā me uppajjati ca veti cā’ti iccassa evamāgataṃ hoti.
segments.mn148:15.6: Iti mano anattā, dhammā anattā, manoviññāṇaṃ anattā, manosamphasso anattā, vedanā anattā.
segments.mn148:15.7: “‘Taṇhā attā’ti yo vadeyya taṃ na upapajjati.
segments.mn148:15.9: Yassa kho pana uppādopi vayopi paññāyati,‘attā me uppajjati ca veti cā’ti iccassa evamāgataṃ hoti.
segments.mn148:15.12: Iti mano anattā, dhammā anattā, manoviññāṇaṃ anattā, manosamphasso anattā, vedanā anattā, taṇhā anattā.
segments.mn148:16.1: “Ayaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, sakkāyasamudayagāminī paṭipadā – cakkhuṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati;
segments.mn148:17-21.1: rūpe ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati;
segments.mn148:17-21.2: cakkhuviññāṇaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati;
segments.mn148:17-21.3: cakkhusamphassaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati;
segments.mn148:17-21.4: vedanaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati;
segments.mn148:17-21.5: taṇhaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati;
segments.mn148:17-21.6: sotaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati … pe … ghānaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati … pe … jivhaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati … pe … kāyaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati … pe … manaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati, dhamme ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati, manoviññāṇaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati, manosamphassaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati, vedanaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati, taṇhaṃ ‘etaṃ mama, esohamasmi, eso me attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.mn148:22.1: “Ayaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadā – cakkhuṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.mn148:23-27.1: Rūpe ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.mn148:23-27.2: Cakkhuviññāṇaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.mn148:23-27.3: Cakkhusamphassaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.mn148:23-27.4: Vedanaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.mn148:23-27.5: Taṇhaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.mn148:23-27.6: Sotaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati … pe … ghānaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati … jivhaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati … kāyaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati … manaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.mn148:23-27.11: Dhamme ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.mn148:23-27.12: Manoviññāṇaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.mn148:23-27.13: Manosamphassaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.mn148:23-27.14: Vedanaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.mn148:23-27.15: Taṇhaṃ ‘netaṃ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti samanupassati.
segments.mn148:28.1: “Cakkhuñca, bhikkhave, paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso, phassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā.
segments.mn148:28.2: So sukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.mn148:28.4: Dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati.
segments.mn148:28.6: Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno tassā vedanāya samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
segments.mn148:28.8: So vata, bhikkhave, sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayaṃ appahāya dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayaṃ appaṭivinodetvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayaṃ asamūhanitvā avijjaṃ appahāya vijjaṃ anuppādetvā diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro bhavissatīti – netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.mn148:29-33.1: “Sotañca, bhikkhave, paṭicca sadde ca uppajjati sotaviññāṇaṃ … pe … ghānañca, bhikkhave, paṭicca gandhe ca uppajjati ghānaviññāṇaṃ … pe … jivhañca, bhikkhave, paṭicca rase ca uppajjati jivhāviññāṇaṃ … pe … kāyañca, bhikkhave, paṭicca phoṭṭhabbe ca uppajjati kāyaviññāṇaṃ … pe … manañca, bhikkhave, paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso, phassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā.
segments.mn148:29-33.6: So sukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.mn148:29-33.8: Dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno socati kilamati paridevati urattāḷiṃ kandati sammohaṃ āpajjati.
segments.mn148:29-33.10: Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno tassā vedanāya samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti.
segments.mn148:29-33.12: So vata, bhikkhave, sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayaṃ appahāya dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayaṃ appaṭivinodetvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayaṃ asamūhanitvā avijjaṃ appahāya vijjaṃ anuppādetvā diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro bhavissatīti – netaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
segments.mn148:34.1: “Cakkhuñca, bhikkhave, paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ, tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso, phassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā.
segments.mn148:34.2: So sukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.mn148:34.4: Dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno na socati na kilamati paridevati na urattāḷiṃ kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
segments.mn148:34.6: Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno tassā vedanāya samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
segments.mn148:34.8: So vata, bhikkhave, sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayaṃ pahāya dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayaṃ samūhanitvā avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro bhavissatīti – ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
segments.mn148:35.1: “Sotañca, bhikkhave, paṭicca sadde ca uppajjati sotaviññāṇaṃ … pe ….
segments.mn148:36.1: “Ghānañca, bhikkhave, paṭicca gandhe ca uppajjati ghānaviññāṇaṃ … pe ….
segments.mn148:37.1: “Jivhañca, bhikkhave, paṭicca rase ca uppajjati jivhāviññāṇaṃ … pe ….
segments.mn148:38.1: “Kāyañca, bhikkhave, paṭicca phoṭṭhabbe ca uppajjati kāyaviññāṇaṃ … pe ….
segments.mn148:39.1: “Manañca, bhikkhave, paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso, phassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā.
segments.mn148:39.2: So sukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.mn148:39.4: Dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷiṃ kandati na sammohaṃ āpajjati.
segments.mn148:39.6: Adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno tassā vedanāya samudayañca atthaṅgamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ pajānāti.
segments.mn148:39.8: So vata, bhikkhave, sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayaṃ pahāya dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayaṃ paṭivinodetvā adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayaṃ samūhanitvā avijjaṃ pahāya vijjaṃ uppādetvā diṭṭheva dhamme dukkhassantakaro bhavissatīti – ṭhānametaṃ vijjati.
segments.mn148:40.1: “Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmiṃ [cakkhusmimpi (syā. kaṃ.) evamitaresupi] nibbindati, rūpesu nibbindati, cakkhuviññāṇe nibbindati, cakkhusamphasse nibbindati, vedanāya nibbindati, taṇhāya nibbindati.
segments.mn148:41.1: Sotasmiṃ nibbindati, saddesu nibbindati … pe … ghānasmiṃ nibbindati, gandhesu nibbindati … jivhāya nibbindati, rasesu nibbindati … kāyasmiṃ nibbindati, phoṭṭhabbesu nibbindati … manasmiṃ nibbindati, dhammesu nibbindati, manoviññāṇe nibbindati, manosamphasse nibbindati, vedanāya nibbindati, taṇhāya nibbindati.
segments.mn148:41.6: Nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati. Vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
segments.mn148:41.7: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyā’ti pajānātī”ti.
segments.mn148:41.9: Attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
segments.mn148:41.10: Imasmiṃ kho pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne saṭṭhimattānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsūti.

lines: Tattha ādikalyāṇantiādimhi kalyāṇaṃ bhaddakaṃ niddosaṃ katvā desessāmi.
Iti bhagavā ariyavaṃsaṃ navahi, mahāsatipaṭṭhānaṃ sattahi, mahāassapuraṃ sattahiyeva padehi thomesi.
Idaṃ pana suttaṃ navahi padehi thomesi.
Manāyatanena tebhūmakacittameva kathitaṃ, dhammāyatanena bahiddhā tebhūmakadhammā ca, manoviññāṇena ṭhapetvā dve pañcaviññāṇāni sesaṃ bāvīsatividhaṃ lokiyavipākacittaṃ.
Heṭṭhā kathitānañhi dvinnaṃ saccānaṃ anattabhāvadassanatthaṃ ayaṃ desanā āraddhā.
Ayaṃ kho pana, bhikkhaveti ayampi pāṭiyekko anusandhi.
Ayañhi desanā tiṇṇaṃ gāhānaṃ vasena vaṭṭaṃ dassetuṃ āraddhā.
Dukkhaṃ samudayoti dvinnaṃ saccānaṃ vasena vaṭṭaṃ dassetuntipi vadantiyeva.
Evaṃ vaṭṭaṃ dassetvā idāni tiṇṇaṃ gāhānaṃ paṭipakkhavasena, nirodho maggoti imesaṃ vā dvinnaṃ saccānaṃ vasena vivaṭṭaṃ dassetuṃ ayaṃ kho panātiādimāha.
Evaṃ vivaṭṭaṃ dassetvā idāni tiṇṇaṃ anusayānaṃ vasena puna vaṭṭaṃ dassetuṃ cakkhuñca, bhikkhavetiādimāha.
Evaṃ tiṇṇaṃ anusayānaṃ vasena vaṭṭaṃ kathetvā idāni tesaṃ paṭikkhepavasena vivaṭṭaṃ dassento puna cakkhuñcātiādimāha.
Ṭhānametaṃ vijjatīti ettakeneva kathāmaggena vaṭṭavivaṭṭavasena desanaṃ matthakaṃ pāpetvā puna tadeva sampiṇḍetvā dassento evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhavetiādimāha.
Saṭṭhimattānaṃ bhikkhūnanti ettha anacchariyametaṃ, yaṃ sayameva tathāgate desente saṭṭhi bhikkhū arahattaṃ pattā.
Imañhi suttaṃ dhammasenāpatimhi kathentepi saṭṭhi bhikkhū arahattaṃ pattā, mahāmoggallāne kathentepi, asītimahātheresu kathentesupi pattā eva.
Ādimhi kalyāṇanti ādikoṭṭhāse kalyāṇaṃ etassāti vā ādikalyāṇo, taṃ ādikalyāṇaṃ, ādikalyāṇabhāvo ca dosavigamena icchitabbo.
Yañhi sabbaso vigatadosaṃ, taṃ paripuṇṇaguṇameva hotīti “niddosan”ti vuttaṃ.
Katvāti ca padaṃ,“kalyāṇaṃ katvā bhaddakaṃ katvā”ti purimapadadvayenapi yojetabbaṃ.
“desetabbadhammassa kalyāṇatā dassitā hotī”ti, dutiye pana atthavikappe desetabbadhammassa kalyāṇatā mukhyeneva kathitā itarassa atthāpattito.
Ayañca desanāya thomanā buddhānaṃ āciṇṇasamāciṇṇāvāti dassetuṃ,“iti bhagavā ariyavaṃsan”tiādi vuttaṃ.
Dhammaggahaṇampi desanāya thomanā evāti “navahi padehī”ti vuttaṃ.
Vedanā yāthāvato jānanaṃ, tañca maggakiccaṃ, tassa upāyo vipassanātiāha –
Dhammāyatanassa vā āyatanabhāvato bahiddhā gahaṇaṃ, na sabbaso anajjhattabhāvato.
Vipākavedanāpaccayā javanakkhaṇe uppannataṇhāti chattiṃsavipākavedanaṃ nissāya evaṃ assādentī anubhaveyyanti akusalajavanakkhaṇato uppannataṇhā.

Heṭṭhāti viññāṇaphassavedanātaṇhānaṃ paccayāyattavuttitādassanena cakkhāyatanādīnaṃ rūpāyatanādīnañca paccayāyattavuttitā dīpitā apaccayuppannassa paccayābhāvato, yañca paccayāyattavuttikaṃ, taṃ aniccaṃ uppādasambhavato, yadaniccaṃ taṃ dukkhaṃ, yaṃ dukkhaṃ tadanattāti khandhapañcake ca channaṃ chakkānaṃ vasena ghanavinibbhogakaraṇena atthato anattalakkhaṇaṃ vibhāvitaṃ.
Na sarūpatoti sarūpatopi taṃ vibhāvetukāmo teneva chachakkānaṃ vasena ghanavinibbhoganayena byatirekato ca anvayato ca dassento bhagavā –
“cakkhu attāti yo vadeyyā”tiādimāhāti yathānusandhikāva desanā vibhāvitā.
Heṭṭhā pana channaṃ chakkānaṃ vasena vinibbhogadassanamattaṃ, na anattalakkhaṇaṃ vibhāvitaṃ, idha pana sarūpato anattalakkhaṇaṃ vibhāvitanti adhippāyena anusandhantarabhāvajotanā.
Yadipi anattabhāvo nāma catūsupi saccesu labbhateva, sabbepi hi dhammā anattā, ime panettha dvepi nayā sammasanavasena pavattāti vuttaṃ –
Na upapajjatīti upapattisaṅkhātayuttiyā na sametīti ayamettha atthoti āha “na yujjatī”ti.
“nicco dhuvo sassato”ti abhimato, cakkhuñca uppādavantatāya aniccaṃ, yaṃ paccayāyatthavuttitā, tasmā “cakkhu attāti yo vadeyya, taṃ na upapajjatī”tiādi.
Sakkāyavatthu cakkhu anattā aniccabhāvato seyyathāpi ghaṭo, cakkhuṃ aniccaṃ paccayāyattavuttibhāvato seyyathāpi ghaṭo, cakkhu paccayāyattavutti uppādādisambhavato seyyathāpi ghaṭo.
Kilesuppatti ca taṇhādiggāhapubbikā, tasmā “tiṇṇaṃ vā gāhānaṃ vasena vaṭṭaṃ dassetun”ti āha.
Yasmā pana taṇhāpakkhikā dhammā samudayasaccaṃ, cakkhādayo dukkhasaccaṃ, tasmā vuttaṃ –
Tiṇṇaṃ gāhānaṃ paṭipakkhavasenāti taṇhādiggāhapaṭipakkhabhūtānaṃ dukkhāniccānattānupassanānaṃ vasena, tāhi vā tiṇṇaṃ gāhānaṃ paṭipakkhavasena viniveṭhanavasena anuppādanavasenāti attho.
Sakkāyanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti ettha nirodhadhammo sarūpeneva dassitoti āha –
Taṇhādīnaṃ anupādiyanavacanāni taṇhādiṭṭhivaseneva vuttāni taṇhādiṭṭhīnaṃyeva abhinandanādivasena pavattisabbhāvato.
“anusetīti appahīno hotī”ti ariyamaggena hi appahīno thāmagato rāgādikileso anusayo kāraṇalābhe sati uppajjanārahabhāvato.
Yaṃ panettha vattabbaṃ, taṃ heṭṭhā vuttameva.
Kāmaṃ heṭṭhimamaggañāṇampi avijjāpahāyinī vijjā eva, taṃ pana ñāṇaṃ avijjāya anavasesappahāyakaṃ na hoti, aggamaggañāṇe pana uppanne avijjāya lesopi nāvasissatīti tadeva avijjāya pahāyakanti āha –
Sayameva tathāgate attano buddhānubhāvena desente saṭṭhi bhikkhū arahattaṃ pattāti anacchariyametaṃ, atha kiṃ acchariyanti āha “iman”tiādi.
Kathentepīti ettha iti saddo pakārattho, imināva pakārenāti attho.
Pattā evāti saṭṭhi bhikkhū arahattaṃ pattā evāti yojanā.
Etampi anacchariyaṃ, satthu sammukhā sāvakā samudāgamā mahābhiññā pabhinnapaṭisambhidā tathā tathā sappāṭihāriyaṃ dhammaṃ desentīti.
Te hi nissāya na kadāci saddhā sambhavati, tesaṃ pana diṭṭhānugatiāpajjanena aññadatthu asaddhiyameva vaḍḍhati, tasmā te paṭibhayamaggo viya dūrato vajjetabbā.
Assaddhiyanti ca saddhāya paṭipakkhabhūtā asaddheyyavatthusmiṃ adhimuccanākārena pavattā saṃkilesadhammā veditabbā.
Te hi nissāya saddheyyavatthusmiṃ anuppannā uppajjati, uppannā bhiyyobhāvaṃ vepullaṃ āpajjati.
Te hi paccavekkhato buddhādīsu anuppannā pasannā upajjati, uppannā bhiyyobhāvaṃ vepullaṃ āpajjati.
Paṭipakkhadūrībhāvato paccekaṃ sūpahārato ca āsevanaṃ bhāvanaṃ labhanti.
Ayaṃ pana viseso – kusīteti alase sammāpaṭipattiyaṃ nikkhittadhure.
Sammappadhāneti anuppannānaṃ akusalānaṃ anuppādanādivasena pavatte cattāro upāyappadhāne.
Te hi paccavekkhato līnaṃ abhibhavitvā sammadeva ārambhadhātuādi anuppannānaṃ vidhinā satisampadāya uppādāya bhiyyobhāvāya saṃvattati.
Tesañhi paccavekkhaṇā uparūpari accantameva samādhānāya saṃvattati.
Duppaññeti nippaññe, ariyadhammassa uggahaparipucchāsavanasammasanābhāvena sabbaso paññārahite ca.
Gambhīrañāṇacariyanti gambhīraṃ khandhāyatanadhātusaccapaṭiccasamuppādādibhedaṃ ñāṇassa caritabbaṭṭhānaṃ, yattha vā gambhīrañāṇassa cariyaṃ pavattati.
Tattha hi paccavekkhaṇā sammohaṃ vidhamati, anuppannāya paññāya uppādāya bhiyyobhāvāya saṃvattati.
Pubbe saddhindriyādīnaṃ visuddhikāraṇāni,“vimuttiparipācanīyā dhammā”ti vuttānīti idha saddhādike aññe ca dhamme dassento,“aparepī”tiādimāha.
Tattha saddhādīnaṃ vimuttiparipācanīyatā dassitā eva, aniccasaññādīnaṃ pana vimuttiparipācanīyatāya vattabbameva natthi vipassanābhāvato.
Kalyāṇamittatādayoti kalyāṇamittatā sīlasaṃvaro abhisallekhakathā vīriyārambho nibbedhikā paññā ime kalyāṇamittatādayo pañca dhammā.
Ayamettha saṅkhepo, vitthāro pana “meghiyasuttasaṃvaṇṇanāyaṃ”(udā. aṭṭha.31) vuttanayena veditabbo.
Āyasmato rāhulassa indriyānaṃ paripakkattā saddhiṃ paṭṭhapitapatthanā devatā udikkhamānā tiṭṭhanti,–
“kadā nu kho uttari āsavānaṃ khaye vinessatī”ti.
Yadā pana satthā evaṃ parivitakkesi, tāvadeva samānajjhāsayatāya sabbakālaṃ taṅkhaṇaṃ āgamentiyo tā devatāyo taṃ samavāyaṃ disvā ekasmiṃ andhavanasmiṃyeva sannipatitā.

Upālissa gahapatino dīghanakhaparibbājakassa catusaccadhammesu dassanakiccena pavatto sotāpattimaggoti tesu suttesu (paṭi. ma. aṭṭha.2.2.30) paṭhamamaggo “dhammacakkhun”ti vutto, tassa dassanatthassa sātisayattā, brahmāyuno pana phalañāṇāni heṭṭhimāni tīṇi sātisayānīti brahmāyusutte (ma. ni.2.383 ādayo) tīṇi phalāni “dhammacakkhun”ti vuttāni.
Idaṃ panettha āyasmato rāhulassa maggañāṇaṃ phalañāṇañca dassanattho sātisayo, tāhi ca devatāhi yaṃ ñāṇaṃ adhigataṃ, taṃ sātisayamevāti vuttaṃ –
“imasmiṃ sutte cattāro maggā, cattāri ca phalāni dhammacakkhunti veditabbānī”ti.
Kiṃ pana sāvakānaṃ saccābhisamayañāṇe atthi koci visesoti?
So ca kho pubbabhāge vuṭṭhānagāminivipassanāya pavattiyākāravisesena labheyya kāci visesamattā.
Svāyamattho abhidhamme “no ca kho yathā diṭṭhippattassā”ti saddhāvimuttato diṭṭhippattassa kilesappahānaṃ pati visesakittanena dīpetabbo.
Kiṃ pana āyasmā rāhulo viya tā devatā sabbā ekacittā pageva cattāri phalāni adhigaṇhiṃsūti?
Kittakā pana tā devatāti āha “tāsañca panā”tiādi.
